# binja

> Bun-first Jinja/Django-style template engine with runtime rendering, static AOT compilation, adapters, and documented Handlebars/Liquid/Twig subsets.

Repository: https://github.com/egeominotti/binja
Documentation: https://egeominotti.github.io/binja/
Runtime requirement: Bun >=1.3.14
Package version in this checkout: 0.9.3

## Compatibility statement

The core is a broad tested subset, not a complete Python Jinja2 or Django Templates implementation. Handlebars, Liquid, and Twig modules are compatibility subsets and do not provide every upstream helper, tag, loader, host object, extension, or coercion rule.

## Install

```sh
bun add binja
```

## Core APIs

```ts
import { Environment, compile, render } from 'binja'

const oneOff = await render('Hello {{ name }}', { name: 'Ada' })

const env = new Environment({
  templates: './views',
  extensions: ['.html', '.jinja', '.jinja2', ''],
  autoescape: true,
  cache: true,
  cacheMaxSize: 100,
})
const page = await env.render('pages/home.html', context)

const renderCard = compile('<h2>{{ title|upper }}</h2>')
const card = renderCard({ title: 'Status' })
```

`render()`/`Environment` are asynchronous. Core `compile()` returns a synchronous AOT function. Secondary-engine `compile()` functions return asynchronous parsed-runtime functions.

## Environment options

```ts
interface EnvironmentOptions {
  templates?: string
  extensions?: string[]
  autoescape?: boolean
  filters?: Record<string, (value: any, ...args: any[]) => any>
  globals?: Record<string, any>
  urlResolver?: (name: string, args: any[], kwargs: Record<string, any>) => string
  staticResolver?: (path: string) => string
  cache?: boolean
  cacheMaxSize?: number
  debug?: boolean
  debugOptions?: PanelOptions
  timezone?: string
}
```

Methods: `render`, `renderString`, `compile` (source to AST), `loadTemplate`, `addFilter`, `addGlobal`, `addUrl`, `addUrls`, `cacheSize`, `cacheStats`, `clearCache`.

## Core syntax

```jinja
{{ user.name }}
{{ items.0 }}
{{ value|default:'fallback'|upper }}

{% if enabled %}yes{% elif pending %}pending{% else %}no{% endif %}

{% for item in items %}
  {{ loop.index }}. {{ item }}
{% empty %}
  Empty
{% endfor %}

{% set total = price * quantity %}
{% with label=title %}{{ label }}{% endwith %}
```

Inheritance/includes require a configured Environment loader:

```jinja
{% extends 'base.html' %}
{% block content %}
  {% include 'card.html' with item=featured %}
{% endblock %}
```

## AOT

`compile()` supports common expressions, built-in filters/tests, conditions, loops, set/with, autoescape, spaceless, comments, and raw text. It rejects dynamic loading and runtime-only tags. `compileWithInheritance()` flattens literal dependencies below a configured root.

`compileToCode()` returns a helper-dependent function fragment. Use `binja compile` for a complete importable ESM module.

## Registries

Current exported counts are 91 filter entries and 35 test entries, including aliases. Inspect `Object.keys(builtinFilters)` and `Object.keys(builtinTests)` for exact names.

Important filters: `escape`, `safe`, `escapejs`, `json`, `tojson`, `json_script`, `xmlattr`, `upper`, `lower`, `default`, `length`, `join`, `batch`, `groupby`, `map`, `select`, `reject`, `selectattr`, `rejectattr`, `items`, `keys`, `merge`, `date`, `time`.

Important tests: `defined`, `undefined`, `none`/`null`, `boolean`, `string`, `number`, `integer`, `float`, `mapping`, `iterable`, `sequence`, `empty`, `even`, `odd`, `divisibleby`, comparison aliases, membership, truthiness, `true`, `false`.

## Secondary imports

```ts
import { MultiEngine } from 'binja/engines'
import * as handlebars from 'binja/engines/handlebars'
import * as liquid from 'binja/engines/liquid'
import * as twig from 'binja/engines/twig'
```

Direct secondary APIs do not expose an external partial/template loader. Liquid `break`/`continue` are rejected. Handlebars custom helper/partial registration, Shopify theme objects, and Symfony/Twig extensions/macros are outside scope.

## Adapters

```ts
import { binja } from 'binja/hono'
// app.use(binja({ root: './views', cache: true }))

import { binja as elysiaBinja } from 'binja/elysia'
```

Options include root, extension, engine, debug, cache, cacheMaxSize, globals, layout, and contentVar.
Templates and layouts share a bounded per-instance LRU cache. Cached edits require eviction or clearCache; cache:false reloads files. Cache hits use validated source without filesystem checks; source loads validate symlinks. Registries automatically clean up discarded adapter instances.

## Security

- Templates are trusted application code, not a sandbox.
- Autoescape defaults to true; `safe`, raw output, and disabled escaping are trust assertions.
- Protected lookup blocks `__proto__`, `prototype`, `constructor`, `caller`, `callee`, and `arguments`.
- Loaders/adapters/CLI reject paths and symlinks outside configured roots.
- Prefer `json_script` for bootstrap JSON. Do not append `safe` to untrusted JSON manually.
- `{% csrf_token %}` only escapes/renders a token supplied as `csrf_token` or `csrfToken`; the host must generate/validate it.
- Debug panels can disclose context/query secrets and are development-only.

## CLI

```sh
binja compile ./views -o ./compiled
binja check ./views
binja watch ./views -o ./compiled
binja lint ./views --format=json
```

## Validation and benchmark

```sh
bun run typecheck
bun run check
bun run test:coverage
bun run build
bun run test:package
BENCH_ROUNDS=15 bun run benchmark -- --json
cd docs && bun run build
```

The benchmark reports local medians, ranges, RSD, and machine/Bun metadata. Do not infer universal competitor ratios from it.
